reviews.title: Make sure the serial number on the board matches the serial number on the box
reviews.comment: This is a really great motherboard for the price. I would definitely recommend checking your serial numbers on the board itself and the box as we received one that had different numbers. When we tried to RMA it for a failing ram slot we were unable to do so because the serial number did not match the CHK number on the board. We have bought 2 more of these since then and they were matching and they work great.
reviews.author: Ivy

reviews.title: Awesome
reviews.comment: Great quality and ease of installation. Ease of use and extra cabling was nice. Best motherboard I've had.
reviews.author: Benjamin Barwiler

reviews.title: 8-Month Review
reviews.comment: This Motherboard has met every one of my needs. I was looking for something that would pair well with my Ryzen 7 7800x3D and I've had zero issues. The install was intuitive and I had zero issues with the delivery. It's been 8 months and I'm still happy with the purchase.
reviews.author: Wyatt P.

reviews.title: Speedy and reliable
reviews.comment: Normally I would just go with the cheapest components I could find, but this is now the 4th pc I've built with an MSI motherboard, and I am now a loyal customer. Every mobo I've purchased from MSI is still going strong and is faster booting and more reliable than others I've used. Flashing bios is easy and I like the bios menu features and ease of use. So far, I've only built pcs for gaming, and MSI has not let me down with what I need. This new one has wifi built in, which is very nice. Also, the look of the board is nicer than I though at first, just seeing the pictures. Whoever designed it, designed a sleek stylish board that I'm happy to own and use. At the end of the day, I don't see myself switching brands when I upgrade or build a new setup. MSI has not let me down, no matter what product I buy from them.
reviews.author: Raymond R. Treadway
